disputes.intro: {{count}} disputes awaiting a decision. Each dispute must be decided within {{hours}} hours of opening, extended once by 48 hours when escalated to a professional reviewer; escrow funds stay locked until then.
disputes.evidence: Evidence: AI draft vs. expert revision

decision.title: Arbitration decision
decision.lockedBody: Nothing is paid out automatically until a decision is made.

escalation.hint: Disputes about professional judgment or a CIT conclusion go to an Authorized Reviewer. The decision deadline is extended by {{hours}} hours, once.
escalation.done: Escalated to professional review; the decision deadline was extended.
escalation.logged: Escalated to an Authorized Reviewer; decision deadline extended by 48 hours

RESOLVE_REFUND_USER.label: Uphold · refund the client
RESOLVE_REFUND_USER.hint: The complaint is justified: the expert breached an obligation, or the client responded on time / the information request was not valid

RESOLVE_PAY_EXPERT.label: Dismiss · pay the expert
RESOLVE_PAY_EXPERT.hint: The complaint is not justified; the expert did the work properly

escrow.title: Refunds and payouts
escrow.intro: Paid out 80/20 after acceptance; refunds follow the termination matrix and dispute decisions.

USER_NON_RESPONSE.label: Client did not answer the information request within 72 hours

USER_CANCELLED_BEFORE_START.label: Client cancelled after paying, before the expert started

EXPERT_ABANDON.label: Expert did not deliver after the deadline and the 24-hour grace period

EXPERT_START_TIMEOUT.label: Expert did not start within 24 hours

drawer.fixRefund: Contact the client for a new refund account, transfer the money, then mark it refunded.

history.intro: Every change to fee ranges, credit prices and packages, newest first.

share.note: Set by platform policy, not editable here. Clients never see the split; they only see the fee the expert sets.

tiers.title: Ranges by template group

credit.note: Price changes apply to new top-ups only; purchased credits stay as they are.

package.noPrice: A package without a price cannot be sold even when on. The paywall only shows priced packages.

tier.outsideNoteTitle: Experts outside the range keep their fee until they update it

tier.scheduled: Scheduled a new range for {{name}} from {{date}}

users.title: Users
users.description: Every account on the platform. Locking an account blocks sign-in; their data and history are kept.

drawer.self: This is your own account and cannot be locked.

action.lockBody: They cannot sign in until unlocked. Work in progress is not deleted.
action.unlockBody: They can sign in again right away.
action.resetBody: A reset link goes to {{email}}. You never see or set the password for them.

eligibility.title: Gate 1 · Eligibility
eligibility.subtitle: Assess each requirement EV-01 – EV-06. The overall outcome is derived automatically. Eligible does not list the expert on the Marketplace yet: per-service competency review and final approval follow.
eligibility.notePlaceholder: State what is missing or why it is not met
eligibility.experienceBelow: Below the minimum, so Pass is not available.
eligibility.remaining: {{count}} requirement(s) without a result or a required note

ELIGIBLE.notice: The applicant is told they meet the eligibility requirements. Next is the competency review for each service; the profile is not on the Marketplace yet.

NEED_MORE_INFORMATION.notice: The application goes back to the applicant with the note of each requirement to supplement. They supplement the same application.

NOT_ELIGIBLE.notice: The application is closed. The applicant sees the note of each failed requirement and can only apply again after the policy waiting period. This cannot be undone.

dialog.title: Record the Gate 1 outcome for {{name}}?
dialog.placeholder: Shown to the applicant with the results.

eligibility.reapplyAt: A new application is allowed from {{date}}.
eligibility.notReviewable: This application is not waiting for a Gate 1 decision.

errors.INVALID_ELIGIBILITY_CRITERIA: Give exactly one result for each of EV-01 – EV-06.
errors.INVALID_ELIGIBILITY_RESULT: A result is invalid. Reload the page and try again.
errors.ELIGIBILITY_NOTE_REQUIRED: A failed or incomplete requirement needs a note.
errors.EXPERIENCE_BELOW_MINIMUM: EV-06 cannot pass: the declared experience is below the minimum.
errors.SELF_REVIEW_NOT_ALLOWED: You cannot review your own application.
errors.APPLICATION_NOT_IN_REVIEW: This application no longer waits for a decision; reload to see its status.
errors.failed: The decision was not recorded. Please try again.

qualifications.title: Competency review by service
qualifications.description: Gate 2: eligible experts register each service separately. Assess C1 – C5 per service; a pass goes to the System Admin for final approval.

competency.title: Gate 2 · Competency for the service
competency.subtitle: Assess each competency C1 – C5. Every competency needs a note; Pass or Fail must cite at least one file. Years of experience or CV keywords never prove a competency on their own.

names.C1: CIT knowledge for the service scope

hints.C3: Related task T1; supports decision T4.

competency.noFiles: No files in this qualification yet.
competency.notePlaceholder: Basis of the assessment, or what is missing
competency.remaining: {{count}} competencies still need a result, a note or a supporting file

PENDING_FINAL_APPROVAL.notice: The qualification goes to the System Admin for final approval, who must not be the Gate 2 reviewer. The expert is not on the Marketplace yet.

NEED_MORE_INFORMATION.notice: The qualification goes back to the expert with the note of each competency to supplement, in the same qualification.

FAIL.notice: This service qualification closes. The expert can register the service again only after the policy wait. Other services are not affected. This cannot be undone.

dialog.title: Gate 2 conclusion for {{name}} · {{service}}?
dialog.placeholder: The expert sees it with the results.

competency.handoff: Waiting for the System Admin final approval.
competency.reapplyAt: The service can be registered again from {{date}}.

errors.INVALID_COMPETENCY_CRITERIA: Give exactly one result for each of C1 – C5.
errors.INVALID_COMPETENCY_RESULT: A result is invalid. Reload the page and try again.
errors.COMPETENCY_NOTE_REQUIRED: Every competency needs an assessment note.
errors.COMPETENCY_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED: Pass or Fail must cite at least one file.
errors.COMPETENCY_EVIDENCE_UNKNOWN: A cited file does not belong to this qualification. Reload and try again.

errors.QUALIFICATION_NOT_PENDING_APPROVAL: The qualification is no longer waiting for final approval; reload to see its status.

errors.INVALID_FINAL_APPROVAL_DECISION: The decision is invalid. Reload the page and try again.
errors.SERVICE_NOT_APPROVED: Only an approved service can be suspended; reload the page.

errors.SUSPENSION_NOTE_REQUIRED: Give the reason for the suspension.
errors.INVALID_SERVICE_ACCESS_ACTION: The action is invalid. Reload the page and try again.

finalApproval.title: Final approval
finalApproval.description: Governance check of Gate 2 results per service: records, both Gate results, evidence and history. Competency is not re-assessed.
finalApproval.intro: Confirm the Gate 2 result is complete and followed the process. Approval lets the expert set up pricing for this service.
finalApproval.sameReviewer: You were the Gate 2 reviewer for this qualification, so you cannot give the final approval.
finalApproval.notePlaceholder: Missing records, unresolved flags or a process error
finalApproval.notPending: This qualification is not waiting for final approval.
finalApproval.suspendIntro: Suspending hides this service from the Marketplace and stops new requests; running cases continue. The expert's other services are not affected.
finalApproval.reinstateIntro: Reinstate so the expert can offer this service again.

pricingReview.title: Service price review
pricingReview.description: The first price and changes of at most 50% are approved automatically. This page only lists larger changes, which a System Admin decides.

errors.PRICING_NOTE_REQUIRED: Explain why it is returned or rejected.
